releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.17 — quicker keys and real chat management. Typing is lighter: the composer no longer redraws the conversation, so each keystroke only touches the input field. Long-press any chat for the menu you were missing: pin it to the top, mute its notifications, mark it read, or delete it after a confirmation. Pinned chats sort above the rest with a pin marker, muted ones show a bell-off marker, and every action confirms with a toast.
